turn.content: The contract confirms 14 calendar days — no clause permits 7. The invoice lines also match the PO exactly (prices and quantities), so the payment-terms discrepancy is the only issue.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "payment_terms_mismatch", "line": null, "cause": "payment_terms_shorter", "evidence": [{"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-022#5.1", "detail": "The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 14 calendar days of the invoice date."}, {"kind": "vendor", "ref": "V-022", "detail": "Payment terms on file for Golden Systems Ltd are 14 days."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "GSL-26-00556", "detail": "Invoice states payment_terms_days = 7, i.e. 7 days shorter than the agreed 14."}], "explanation": "The invoice demands payment in 7 days, but the signed contract (clause KTR-V-022#5.1) and the vendor's terms on file both fix 14 calendar days from the invoice date, and no contract clause allows a shorter period, so the stated terms are too short."}]}
